title: Review an uncommitted feature in /home/n3o/code/aura-harness (Rust) for bugs, regressions and missing tests. Read-only:…
summary: I found no blocking bugs. Two medium issues are worth fixing before merge: an overlapping submenu can let a click run a hidden menu item, and a tab can get stuck showing an agent whose project was moved out. Both test runs pass: `cargo test -p aura-ui-terminal context_menu` (24 tests) and `cargo test -p aura-desktop router` (28 tests).
